terminal-bench-2.1.reason: its solution installs pyknotid's dependency planarity without a version, and planarity 1.0.0 names the node attribute vertex_position where pyknotid 0.5.3 reads pos, so the repository test test_reconstructed_space_curve that the verifier runs ends in KeyError: 'pos'.

its solution runs john with no mode, whose single mode tries 9,782 candidates before the wordlist that holds the password and computes them one at a time when john sees one core, so on a slot that shows exactly the one CPU the task grants it runs out of its 1,800 s unless the core is fast, and it passes where john sees several cores under the same CPU time, as under Docker.

its solution installs rstan 2.32.7 through remotes, which takes the newest release of every dependency whatever the lines before it pinned: RcppParallel 6 needs cmake, which the image does not have, so rstan is never installed, and with RcppParallel held back StanHeaders 2.39 rejects the array syntax of the solution's model.

its solution reads the residues of a chromophore from a feature of type modified_monomer, which the RCSB data API names non_standard_monomer since September 2026, so an X stays in two sequences and DnaChisel ends in NoSolutionError.
